resources.string: Real-Time Game Screen OCR, Accessibility Reader & Hindi Voice Dubber
Reads English subtitles and on-screen text from running games using Accessibility & OCR, translates them to Hindi, and speaks them out loud via TextToSpeech.
Required to display the draggable circular control icon and live OCR debug readout over games.
Required on Android 13+ to keep the floating translator service running smoothly.
Reading game subtitles (Accessibility + OCR + Hindi TTS)
Floating icon ready — Single tap to scan & speak
